raw.title: Add OpenAPI Breaking Change Checker
raw.body:
> **This tool is not hosted in a public GitHub repository.**

## Tool Properties

- Display name: OpenAPI Breaking Change Checker
- Description: Free browser tool that compares Swagger 2.0 and OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 JSON or YAML descriptions locally and reports likely client-breaking, review-needed, and compatible changes. Internal JSON Pointer references are resolved; external references are reported but not fetched.
- Repository: Not open source; no public repository.
- Homepage: https://martingruner.com/tools/openapi-breaking-change-checker

## OpenAPI Versions

- 3.1: true
- 3.0: true
- 2.0: true
